title: iva pedicellata
intro: Iva pedicellata, commonly known as Poverty Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating wounds, and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Iva pedicellata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to promote wound healing, reduce oxidative stress, and modulate immune responses.
